notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness. There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Wirewood Channeler.
description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Wirewood Channeler
Repeat.
